reviews.text:
Interesting cake combination to cleanse the face.

I like that it is option to 2-n-1 cleanser, important when i only have spf and not heavy makeup. 

Though it is good, I still prefer Arencia mochi black tea, it suits my oily skin more. Though there days when skin is more sensitive I switch to Aprilskin
reviews.zh:
用嚟潔面嘅 cake 組合幾特別。

我鍾意佢可以做成二合一潔面產品，對我嚟講好重要，因為我只係擦咗防曬，冇化濃妝。

雖然呢款都幾好，但我仍然比較鍾意 Arencia mochi black tea，因為佢更啱我嘅油性皮膚。不過有啲日子皮膚比較敏感，我就會轉用 Aprilskin。

reviews.text: I use this cleanser every single day along with another cleanser and let me tell you it’s one of the best cleansers out there it does have a slight fragrance so that might be something to take in for sensible skin girlies!but on the other hand literally leaves my skin smooth for days!!bumpy nose/dry nose? GONE!!get it now girlies!
reviews.zh: 我每日都同另一款潔面一齊用，我話你知，佢係市面上最好嘅潔面產品之一。佢有少少香味，所以敏感肌膚嘅女仔要留意吓！不過另一方面，佢真係可以令皮膚幾日都好幼滑！！鼻位凹凸／鼻位乾燥？冇晒啦！！快啲入手啦，女仔哋！

reviews.text: I have to be honest, I bought this because it looked sooo pretty in the packaging and ingredients seemed very straightforward. But the very first time I used it I was stunned! My face felt clean clean but not as if my skin was tight and dry, just clean and it was literally glowing! My skin looked more hydrated after I washed and I have truly dry skin. The way in which you can use this as a face mask for 2 mins is also so great, it really helps soften sebum and reduce appearance of black heads.
reviews.zh: 我要老實講，我買呢款係因為包裝好靚，而且成分睇落好直接。不過第一次用嗰陣，我真係嚇親咗！面好乾淨，但係唔會覺得皮膚緊繃同乾燥，就係乾淨，而且真係有光澤！洗完之後皮膚睇落更加水潤，而我嘅皮膚真係好乾燥。你可以當面膜敷兩分鐘嗰個方法都好好，真係有助軟化皮脂，減低黑頭嘅明顯程度。

reviews.text: A creamy, dual-action cleanser and mask infused with pink aloe and hyaluronic acid to deeply hydrate while purifying the skin. It gently removes impurities and buildup without stripping moisture, leaving your complexion fresh, smooth, and radiant. Perfect for dry or sensitive skin needing a soothing yet effective cleanse.
reviews.zh: 一款奶霜質地嘅雙效潔面兼面膜產品，加入粉紅蘆薈同透明質酸，深層補水，同時淨化皮膚。佢可以溫和去除污垢同堆積物，又唔會洗走水分，令膚色清新、幼滑、有光澤。非常適合需要舒緩又有效潔面嘅乾性或敏感皮膚。

reviews.text: This cleansing foam has quickly become one of my skincare favorites. It creates a rich, gentle lather that removes dirt, oil, and makeup without drying out my skin. After washing, my face feels clean, refreshed, and smooth, with no tightness. I’ve also noticed that my pores look clearer and my skin tone more balanced over time. The texture and light scent make it a pleasure to use every day. A perfect choice for anyone looking for an effective yet gentle cleanser!
reviews.zh: 呢款潔面泡沫好快就成為我最鍾意嘅護膚產品之一。佢起嘅泡豐富、溫和，可以去除污垢、油脂同化妝品，又唔會令皮膚乾燥。洗完之後，面感覺乾淨、清新、幼滑，冇緊繃感。我仲留意到，隨住時間過去，我嘅毛孔睇落更加清晰，膚色亦更加平衡。質地同淡淡嘅香味令每日用都係一種享受。對於想搵一款有效又溫和嘅潔面產品嘅人嚟講，係一個完美選擇！

reviews.text:
This cleanser not only is the prettiest I have ever used but it also works sooo well - Also it smells amazing, like Citrus.
It can be used as a cleanser, as a scrub and as a mask. I mainly used it as a cleanser and was fantastic. I never felt my skin so clean after one single product. I absolutely adore it and would recommend it
reviews.zh:
呢款潔面產品唔單止係我用過最靚嘅一款，效果都好好——而且聞落好香，有柑橘嘅味道。
佢可以用嚟潔面、磨砂，又可以當面膜用。我主要用嚟潔面，效果都好出色。我從來未試過只用一款產品，皮膚就咁乾淨。我好鍾意，會推薦畀其他人。

reviews.text: right now my skin is very sensitive and my pores are very clogged, this cleansing pack is so good at removing dead skin cells and cleaning out my pores while still being gentle and hydrating. you need so little product for cleansing your face, I think this will last me months. I was afraid tiktok was overhyping this product but they’re actually selling it short! VERY recommend this!🩷
reviews.zh: 而家我嘅皮膚好敏感，毛孔亦都好堵，呢款潔面膜好擅長去除死皮同清潔毛孔，同時仍然好溫和、補水。潔面嘅時候只需要好少產品，我覺得可以用好多個月。我之前擔心 TikTok 將呢款產品吹得太誇張，但係佢哋其實係低估咗佢！非常推薦！🩷

reviews.text: The AprilSkin Pink Aloe Pack Cleanser is a fantastic multi-use product! It gently cleanses the skin while providing a soothing and hydrating effect, thanks to the aloe extract. The creamy texture is easy to apply, and it leaves your skin feeling soft and refreshed without stripping away natural moisture. Plus, the subtle fragrance is pleasant and not overpowering. A great addition to any skincare routine, especially for sensitive skin like mine.
reviews.zh: AprilSkin Pink Aloe Pack Cleanser 係一款超好用嘅多用途產品！因為含有蘆薈萃取，佢可以溫和潔面，同時帶嚟舒緩同補水嘅效果。奶霜質地易於塗抹，用完之後令皮膚感覺柔軟、清爽，又唔會洗走天然水分。另外，佢嘅淡香味好舒服，唔會太濃。係任何護膚程序都好好嘅新增產品，特別係好似我咁嘅敏感皮膚。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
